research_role: Replace the five-card mechanism baseline with a compact but genuinely retrievable strategy catalog without returning to the noisy 11,590 raw-response cards.

additional_execution_or_context_variants.allowed_only_when: The variant changes a decision boundary, dialogue phase, goal, burden, risk constraint, or generator instruction in a way that can change the response.

card_unit.is: A reusable support move with a distinct when-to-use rule, when-not-to-use rule, execution instruction, burden level, and risk constraints.
is_not: one topic-specific copy of an existing move

source_support_gate.eligible_source_pool: The 6,391 outcome-blind, packet-disjoint, filtered ESConv train lineage rows already retained by Strategy Bank V2.

distinctness_gate.high_semantic_similarity_action: Human merge-or-justify review; similarity alone cannot delete a safety-relevant boundary variant.
distinctness_gate.same_move_different_metadata_action: Use metadata tags on one card unless the prompt instruction or permitted behavior actually changes.

human_review.first_reviewer: All surviving cards receive intrinsic content review.
human_review.second_reviewer: All high-risk or ambiguous cards plus a fixed 20 percent random sample of the remainder.
human_review.response_level_review: Deferred until the catalog is frozen; do not continue the old five-card confirmation as formal evidence for the new catalog.

retrieval_policy.stage_1: Apply observable safety, boundary, family, phase, burden, and risk eligibility filters.
retrieval_policy.stage_2: Rank only the eligible cards with one frozen retriever shared by every PM and baseline.
retrieval_policy.topk_calibration: Compare R0, Top-1, and Top-k only after Top-1 is a strict prefix of the same frozen bank and ranking.

stopping_rule: Stop adding cards when new cards fail the distinctness or minimum-source-support gate.
Do not add topic-only copies to reach 80.
It is acceptable to freeze below 80 if the data supports fewer genuinely distinct cards.
Do not exceed 100 in V1.5; broader or domain-information banks belong to later work.
claim_boundary: The five-card catalog remains a mechanism baseline. Only the frozen, audited V3 catalog may support a Strategy-RAG claim.
